The inbox timeline is merged and live at [/framework/core/Page/ext/Inbox/timeline/](/framework/core/Page/ext/Inbox/timeline/). It shows 1,096 things built and 70 waiting on you, newest and most urgent first. Each row opens beside the rail with its card's chat. Rows you've opened drop out of the list but are never deleted ("Seen too" brings them back, "Mark all seen" clears the rest), and Today/Yesterday chips scope it to a day.

The rail bug is fixed too. Opening Today took over the whole view because day pages weren't on the list of pages that keep the rail. The "AI" title now takes you back. Before/after shots are in `inbox-data/rail-bug/`.

⚠ New landings don't reach the timeline by themselves yet. That needs one line added to `Server/on-landing.mjs`, which was outside what I was allowed to edit. The exact line is in [doc/inbox-data.md](/framework/core/Page/ext/Inbox/doc/inbox-data.md), and it's pinned in your Inbox as a note.
